subject.title: fix(agent): exit nonzero when gateway runs do not complete

question: Should gateway timeout, error, and cancelled terminal envelopes consistently produce CLI exit code 1 for existing automation, while a final stop result remains successful?
rationale: The change fixes the reported false-success behavior but deliberately alters the externally observable exit-status contract used by scripts and CI.

options.title: Confirm failure exit contract
options.body: Accept the compatibility change and merge after required checks validate the current merge result.

options.title: Preserve legacy exit behavior
options.body: Keep exit code 0 for these envelopes and pursue a separately designed opt-in strict completion contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm failure exit contract
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility change and merge after required checks validate the current merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation author supplied the runtime proof and can clarify the exact observed gateway/CLI contract during maintainer review.
